holder-quote: Then Relc activated his Skill. The Skill of battlefields. It had been a long, long time since he had used it. Not when Skinner attacked. Not when monsters threatened.
effect-quote: A dead Drake, wearing epaulets and the crest of a city they didn’t know. Yet perfect in every detail. Someone who had once been; not a figment of their imagination. He stared at them through a hole in his throat.

holder-quote: Lulv ignored the bodies of the dead clawing at his feet, but he shifted his stance, keeping back
He sank into a killing stance, ready to dash.
